articles.title: Grid challenges mount as rooftop solar expands; Kerala, Maharashtra explore battery storage
articles.description: Growing rooftop solar installations in India present grid management challenges, prompting states like Kerala and Maharashtra to explore battery storage solutions and Uttar Pradesh to initiate tenders for government building installations.

articles.title: Jogen Chowdhury: An artist who did not need to shout to be heard
articles.description: Jogen was a true Indian original, untouched by the compulsions of fashionable, derivative art practices or the need to perform importance for the media.
